name: Website Speed Test
seoTitle: Free Website Speed Test — Core Web Vitals Checker
metaDescription: Test your website speed for free. Get real Core Web Vitals data (LCP, CLS, INP) from Google PageSpeed Insights, plus plain-English fixes.
intro: A slow website loses customers before they even see what you offer — and Google penalises slow pages in search rankings too. Our free website speed test uses Google's own PageSpeed Insights data to show you exactly which Core Web Vitals are failing and what's causing it.
whatWeCheck: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) — how fast your main content appears
Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) — visual stability while loading
Interaction to Next Paint (INP) — responsiveness to clicks and taps
Unused CSS and JavaScript bloating load time

faq.question: Why is my website slow?
faq.answer: The most common causes are unoptimised images, render-blocking CSS/JavaScript, missing text compression, and no browser caching. Our speed test pinpoints exactly which of these apply to your site, using real Google PageSpeed Insights data.

faq.question: Does website speed actually affect Google rankings?
faq.answer: Yes — Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) are a confirmed Google ranking factor, and slow sites also see higher bounce rates, which indirectly hurts SEO further.

faq.question: How is this different from Google PageSpeed Insights or GTmetrix?
faq.answer: We use the same underlying PageSpeed Insights data, but translate the technical output into plain-English, prioritised fixes as part of a full site audit — not just a raw score.
